desc: Implement the direct greedy in Solution.generateString (T propagation with conflict detection, left-to-right F fixing by bumping rightmost free slot to 'b', FREE->'a').
Verify the 3 provided examples produce "ababa", "", "a" (re-checked: ex1 -> "ababa", ex2 -> "", ex3 -> "a", all correct).
Self-contained exhaustive + randomized brute-force cross-check (n<=5/{a,b} & {a,b,c}, randomized n<=8,m<=8, and targeted 'b'-run/overlap probes): ~7172 cases, 0 mismatches.
Confirm no counterexample exists so the alternate feasibility-greedy approach is unnecessary; complexity O(n*m) (<= ~5e6 ops) and O(n+m) space is comfortably within limits.
Finalize: submit Solution.generateString alone (with imports if needed), no test harness.
